_source: IISER Bhopal Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) X-Ray Diffraction laboratory
name: Single-Crystal & High-Resolution Powder X-Ray Diffractometer (SC-XRD / PXRD)
model: D8 Venture Dual-Source (Mo/Cu) Photon III & D8 Advance PXRD
specs: Dual microfocus X-ray sources (Mo K-alpha and Cu K-alpha) with CMOS Photon III area detector
Oxford Cryostream low-temperature attachment (90 K to 400 K) for temperature-dependent phase transitions
Laue back-reflection orientation and Rietveld refinement software suite
useCases: Single-crystal crystallographic orientation, space-group determination, and defect analysis for quantum materials (Xtalsphere)
Polymorph screening and phase-purity verification of functional inorganic and pharmaceutical solids
bookingNotes: Crystal dimensions and air/moisture sensitivity must be indicated at the time of booking.
